name: circan_alpha_evolve
title: Circana Omni-Channel Retail Media Flighting & iROAS Optimizer
problem_description: Optimize an 8-week, $2.5M CPG retail media and promotional flighting schedule across 5 Retail Media Networks (Walmart Connect, Target Roundel, Kroger Precision Marketing, Instacart, Amazon Fresh) using Circana Liquid Data response models. Each RMN exhibits a non-convex Hill S-curve response (dead zone below threshold, diminishing returns above inflection), a 3-week household pantry-depletion cannibalization cycle, cross-RMN household reach duplication penalties, discrete minimum flight spend floors ($25k), and weekly store inventory out-of-stock (OOS) caps. Maximize the normalized net incremental sales lift fitness score.
initial_program_description: Naive baseline that allocates the $2.5M campaign budget across the 5 RMNs and 8 weeks proportionally to each RMN's baseline scale without accounting for S-curve inflection thresholds, 3-week pantry stocking cannibalization, cross-RMN household overlap, or weekly store inventory caps.
evolve_block_description: The allocate_rmn_flighting(params) function body that computes and returns the (5, 8) budget allocation matrix in $M across 5 Retail Media Networks and 8 campaign weeks.
constraints: Output must be a 2D numpy float array of shape (5, 8) representing weekly spend in $M per RMN.
All allocations must be non-negative and total spend must not exceed total_budget_musd ($2.50M).
Any non-zero weekly flight must be at least min_flight_musd ($0.025M = $25k) or exactly 0.0.
Must be deterministic and complete within 30 seconds.
